analysis.summary: Mangal Credit and Fincorp Limited reported its financial results and business updates for the quarter ended June 30, 2021. Management highlighted growth in client base, disbursements, and assets under management despite challenges from the second wave of COVID-19. The company also outlined forward-looking targets regarding its topline, loan book, branch expansion, and gold loan segment. Mangal Credit and Fincorp Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the fourth quarter and twelve months ended March 31, 2021. Management highlighted growth in fresh disbursements, net interest income, and total portfolio outstanding, alongside expansion plans in retail branches and digital processing.

guidance.claim: Management expects the topline to grow by 40% by the end of FY22.
guidance.quote: Management expects the topline to grow by 40% by end of FY22.

guidance.claim: The company targets a loan book of Rs. 11000 Lacs by the end of the current fiscal.
guidance.quote: It remains focused to increase their loan book/POS upto Rs. 50,000 lacs by 2025, targeting a loan book of Rs. 11000 Lacs by end of current fiscal.

guidance.claim: Management expects the flagship Gold Loan Lending product to grow by 150% in the current fiscal.
guidance.quote: Management remains committed to grow its flagship product ‘Gold Loan Lending’ and expects it to grow by 150% in current fiscal.

guidance.claim: MCFL aspires to grow its loan book/POS up to 50,000 lacs by 2025 with a balanced product mix and expanding footprints.
guidance.quote: MCEL is prudently aspiring to grow its loan book/POS upto %50,000 lacs by 2025, with a balanced product mix and expanding footprints in western and northern states of India.

guidance.claim: MCFL's focus will remain to expand its footprints in more than 10 new cities translating into approx. 2000+ new clients by the end of FY22.
guidance.quote: MCEFL focus will remain unchanged to expand its footprints in more than 10 new cities in which will translate into approx. 2000+ of new clients by the end of FY22.

demand_outlook.claim: Individuals and businesses sought loans for survival and business continuation due to challenging times from the nation-wide lockdown.
demand_outlook.quote: These challenging times have raised several concerns for viability of several businesses and families. This led to individuals and businesses seek loan for their survival and for continuing of their businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed a growing trend in client base, disbursals, and AUM.
demand_outlook.quote: Consequently, we have seen a growing trend in our client base, disbursals as well as AUM.

demand_outlook.claim: The current challenging times created a great uptrend in the growth of the Gold/Diamond Loan business.
demand_outlook.quote: The current challenging times have brought a great uptrend in the growth of our Gold/Diamond Loan business and we have further moved a step ahead in our expansion plan by setting up yet another retail branch in order to gain more market share.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the gold and diamond jewellery loan industry is expected to grow at a CAGR of about 13.4 percent over FY 2020-2022.
demand_outlook.quote: We are likely to ride the gold and diamond jewellery loan industry wave which is expected to grow at a CAGR of about 13.4 per cent over FY 2020-2022 to reach about INR 4,50,000 crore in FY 2022, with NBFCs leading the way.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated there are growing opportunities arising post Covid19 period in securitized based personal loans as small businesses and individuals require capital.
demand_outlook.quote: We have strong plans and strategies to tap the growing opportunities arising post Covid19 period in securitized based personal loans, as large no. of small business and individuals would require capital to restart and resume operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is spending on setting up a digital infrastructure to make the loan availing process hassle free and gain a competitive edge.
capex_expansion.quote: MICFL has been spending on setting up a digital infrastructure to make the loan availing process hassle free and to gain a competitive edge.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to expand footprints through 10 more branches by the end of FY22.
capex_expansion.quote: These will be achieved by its aggressive expansion plans to expand its footprints through 10 more branches translating it to 1500+ clients by end of FY22.

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced expansion plans of adding 5 more retail branches in areas of Mumbai and Thane.
capex_expansion.quote: strong numbers have prompted us to come up with expansion plans of adding 5 more retail branches in areas of Mumbai and Thane with an aim to become a well-entrenched and dynamic players in this segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened its first branch in Vile Parle, Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: We opened our first branch in Vile Parle, Mumbai and had fresh disbursements of Rs. 1957.15 lacs in just 9 months of operations.
